title: Painting in Gardens
content: I've got tips for painting in the garden coming up in the April/May 2023 issue of International Artist.Here's one of the tips:Leaves are lighter than their surroundings.In a natural setting, leaves get lighter in value at the top of the plant because they receive more illumination than the ones farther down the plant. It’s safe to say that all leaves are lighter than their background, unless they are against the sky, in which case it’s safe to generalize that they’re darker than their background.Here's alink to the magazine.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)
